summary: John's maternal 3rd great-grandmother; contadina of Guardia Lombardi, mother of John Petriello.
bio:
Tree: Grazia Di Marino (b. 1837), daughter of Gaetano di Marino (1795-1876) + Maria d'Ambrosio. Round 2 found a conflict: the FS tree makes her the daughter of Gaetano Di Marino and Caterina di Leo, born c.1837. Round 3 resolved it: death act, Guardia, 9 May 1916, aged 71 (so born c.1845, not 1837), contadina, daughter of the late Gaetano and the late Caterina Di Leo, widow of Pietro Petriello (Morti 1916, act 22). Her mother is therefore Caterina di Leo; Maria d'Ambrosio was probably Gaetano's earlier wife (mother of Concetta di Marino, m. 1855). The tree conflated the two wives. Probable full sister: Maria di Marino, daughter of G[aetano] and Caterina di Leo, m. Nicola di Pietro 12 Feb 1857. Note: if Grazia was born c.1845 and Maria married in 1857, Maria was the elder. A daughter Filomena was born 16 Dec 1885 at Carife per FS (speculative). The surname di Leo matches Fr. Nunzio Di Leo, whose will funded Guardia's St. Rocco chapel after the 1656 plague.

Grazia's FamilySearch profile carries the same three indexed Avellino records as her husband's ([R4-S1]). One names her with her parents Gaetano di Marino and Caterina di Leo and with Pietro Petriello (6PG6-674V); it is probably the couple's marriage act. Another indexes her as 'Grazia De Marino', mother of Filomena Petriello, born 16 Dec 1885 at Carife (QPR6-CHPB). Born c.1845 by her death act, she would have been about 40 at Filomena's birth.

openQuestions: View FS record 1:1:6PG6-674V / 6PG6-674L (probable marriage act) for the marriage date and her age (would refine her birth year).
